narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.content: The serving layer logs are not flowing into the observability stack automatically. Right now, a person manually exports the log files from the application servers and then loads them into the monitoring dashboard. This happens after the nightly forecast run completes. There is no automated pipeline connecting the two systems. The export step requires someone to sit at a terminal and run a specific command sequence to pull the data. Once the files are on the local machine, they are uploaded to the stack through a manual upload interface. This process takes about twenty minutes of focused work each night. If that person is unavailable, the logs do not arrive until the next day, leaving a gap in the visibility of the model performance during that period.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current manual workflow, its duration, and the consequence of unavailability without expressing a wish, refusal, or acceptance of a trade-off.
